Question: mmai pehli bar quarbani karna chahta hoon. kisi ne mughe bataya hai ki pehli bar 2 hisse lene padte hai . yani 1 buffalo me 2 out of seven.sahi tariqua kya bataye. Answer ID: 9206 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1210/1210=M/1429) Ask him for a reference who said that one has to take two share for the first time. As per the Shariah, there is no such condition. One share of qurbani is wajib on a person who is owner of nisab (amount liable for zakah) whether it is his first qurbani or not. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
